import subprocess, json, pathlib, shlex, time, os
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
LOG=ROOT/'logs/commands/edit-replace-execution.log'
LEDGER=ROOT/'logs/commands/edit-replace-evidence.json'
def run(label, command, cwd=ROOT, env=None, timeout=600):
    start=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run(command, shell=isinstance(command,str), cwd=cwd,
        env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=timeout)
    with LOG.open('ab') as f:
        f.write(('\n=== '+label+' ===\nCWD '+str(cwd)+'\nCOMMAND '+str(command)+'\n').encode())
        f.write(b'STDOUT\n'+p.stdout+b'\nSTDERR\n'+p.stderr)
        f.write(('\nSTATUS '+str(p.returncode)+'\n').encode())
    items=json.loads(LEDGER.read_text()) if LEDGER.exists() else []
    items.append(dict(label=label,command=command,cwd=str(cwd),status=p.returncode,
                      duration=time.time()-start))
    LEDGER.write_text(json.dumps(items,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(label, 'status',p.returncode, (p.stdout+p.stderr).decode(errors='replace')[-2500:])
    return p

import pathlib, subprocess, tempfile, re, os
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=os.environ['TMPDIR']) as d:
    cwd=pathlib.Path(d); (cwd/'file').write_bytes(b'old\nkeep')
    p=subprocess.run(['strace','-yy','-e','trace=openat,read,write,fcntl,fchown,fchmod,fsync,close,rename,unlink',
                      str(ROOT/'build/edit-replace'),'file','old','new'],cwd=cwd,
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=20)
    print(p.stderr.decode())
    assert p.returncode==0 and p.stdout==b''
    assert (cwd/'file').read_bytes()==b'new\nkeep'
    trace=p.stderr.decode()
    stage=next(x for x in trace.split('\n') if 'openat(' in x and '.edit-replace-' in x)
    assert 'O_EXCL' in stage and 'O_CREAT' in stage
    source=next(x for x in trace.split('\n') if 'openat(' in x and '"file"' in x)
    assert 'O_RDWR' in source and 'O_TRUNC' not in source and 'O_CREAT' not in source
    relevant=[x for x in trace.split('\n') if (str(cwd) in x or '.edit-replace-' in x) and
              any(x.startswith(z+'(') for z in ['write','fsync','close','rename'])]
    assert not any(x.startswith('write(') and '/file>' in x for x in relevant)
    positions={call:next(i for i,x in enumerate(relevant) if x.startswith(call+'(')
                       and '.edit-replace-' in x) for call in ['write','fsync','close','rename']}
    assert positions['write']<positions['fsync']<positions['close']<positions['rename']
    p=subprocess.run(['strace','-yy','-e','trace=openat,write,rename,unlink',
                      str(ROOT/'build/edit-replace'),'file','absent','new'],cwd=cwd,
                      stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=20)
    print(p.stderr.decode())
    assert p.returncode==0 and '.edit-replace-' not in p.stderr.decode()
    assert not any(x.startswith(('rename(', 'unlink(')) for x in p.stderr.decode().split('\n'))
print('actual syscall ordering, no-source-write and no-match/no-stage checks passed')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Freeze/verify the exact narrow candidate, never stage or commit."""
import argparse
import difflib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import tarfile
ROOT=Path('/home/name/Documents/420-EMBDX/A')
SCRATCH=Path('/home/name/.hermes/cache/scratch/edit-replace-integration')
BASE='705eee07b7b45d3f97f26f9c4e90b6cec2dc21e3'
ALLOWLIST=['Makefile', 'README.md', 'FILES.md', 'src/registry.c', 'src/cmd_edit_replace.c', 'src/cmd_edit_replace.h', 'src/edit_replace_main.c', 'tests/test_edit_replace.py', 'tests/test_edit_replace_module.c', 'tests/test_shell.py', 'tests/test_shell_module.c', 'docs/commands/edit-replace.md', 'docs/commands/shell.md', 'docs/reports/edit-replace-implementation.md', 'logs/commands/edit-replace-execution.log', 'logs/commands/edit-replace-evidence.json']
SCOPED=['src/cmd_edit_replace.c', 'src/cmd_edit_replace.h', 'src/edit_replace_main.c', 'tests/test_edit_replace_module.c', 'src/registry.c', 'tests/test_shell_module.c']
def digest(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
def contents(path):
    return (SCRATCH/path).read_bytes() if path in ('README.md','FILES.md') else (ROOT/path).read_bytes()
def lf_lines(data):
    parts=data.split(b'\n')
    return [part+b'\n' for part in parts[:-1]]+([parts[-1]] if parts[-1] else [])
def patch_build():
    output=b''
    for path in ALLOWLIST:
        p=subprocess.run(['git','show',BASE+':'+path],cwd=ROOT,
                         stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        old=p.stdout if p.returncode==0 else b''
        output+=b''.join(difflib.diff_bytes(difflib.unified_diff,
                 lf_lines(old),lf_lines(contents(path)),
                 fromfile=('a/'+path).encode() if p.returncode==0 else b'/dev/null',
                 tofile=('b/'+path).encode()))
    (SCRATCH/'integration.patch').write_bytes(output)
def check_current(manifest):
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip()==BASE
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'],cwd=ROOT)==b''
    for path, value in manifest['candidate_sha256'].items():
        assert digest(contents(path))==value, path
    for path, value in manifest['anchor_sha256'].items():
        assert digest((ROOT/path).read_bytes())==value, path
    for path, value in manifest['dependency_sha256'].items():
        assert digest((ROOT/path).read_bytes())==value, path
    for path, value in manifest['unrelated_fingerprints'].items():
        file=ROOT/path
        current=digest(file.read_bytes()) if file.is_file() else None
        assert current==value, path
    assert digest((SCRATCH/'integration.patch').read_bytes())==manifest['patch_sha256']
def verify(kind, name):
    manifest=json.loads((SCRATCH/'manifest.json').read_text())
    check_current(manifest)
    target=SCRATCH/name
    target.mkdir()
    archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive',BASE],cwd=ROOT)
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:
        tar.extractall(target,filter='data')
    # Independent proof logs live outside frozen candidate bytes.
    exec((SCRATCH/'runner.py').read_text(),globals())
    globals()['LOG']=SCRATCH/'final-proof.log'
    globals()['LEDGER']=SCRATCH/'final-proof.json'
    p=run(name+'-apply-check',['git','apply','--check',str(SCRATCH/'integration.patch')],cwd=target)
    assert p.returncode==0
    p=run(name+'-apply',['git','apply','--whitespace=nowarn',str(SCRATCH/'integration.patch')],cwd=target)
    assert p.returncode==0
    for path,value in manifest['candidate_sha256'].items():
        assert digest((target/path).read_bytes())==value, path
    for path,value in manifest['anchor_sha256'].items():
        assert digest((target/path).read_bytes())==value, path
    (target/'build').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for name_dep in ['argtable3','cunit']:
        (target/'build'/name_dep).symlink_to(ROOT/'build'/name_dep,target_is_directory=True)
    env=os.environ.copy()
    command=['make','all','test']
    if kind=='sanitizer':
        flags='-std=c17 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Wformat=2 -Wshadow -Wconversion -Wstrict-prototypes -g3 -O0 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -fno-pie'
        command+=['CFLAGS='+flags,'LDFLAGS=-fsanitize=address,undefined -no-pie']
        env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=1:halt_on_error=1',
                   UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1')
    else:
        command+=['lint']
    assert run(name+'-full',command,cwd=target,env=env).returncode==0
    assert run(name+'-main-cli',['python3','tests/test_edit_replace.py','--program',
               './build/main','--prefix','edit-replace'],cwd=target,env=env).returncode==0
    assert run(name+'-format',['clang-format','--dry-run','--Werror',*SCOPED],cwd=target).returncode==0
    for path,value in manifest['candidate_sha256'].items():
        assert digest((target/path).read_bytes())==value, path
    check_current(manifest)
    print(name, 'exact candidate/anchor/dependency hashes and all gates passed')
if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('action',choices=['patch','normal','sanitizer'])
    parser.add_argument('--name',default=None)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.action=='patch':
        patch_build()
    else:
        verify(args.action,args.name or args.action+'-final')
